final_topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
final_topology.description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Azure VNet with a Red Hat OpenShift cluster, a central firewall, and a private connection to the on-premises datacenter.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n17) that manages inventory for multiple nodes and zones, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl3, nl4, nl5, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl3, zl4, etc.), which suggest documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive (z4) and non-sensitive (z5) data, with specific application servers in each zone (n_struct1, n_struct2).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'Application Firewall' (n15) in the Azure VNet (z1), indicating firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n8) in the Azure VNet (z1), which is used for DNS resolution (nl4).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n18) that manages MFA for remote access (nl30).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) in the Azure VNet (z1), which is used for DNS filtering (nl5).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) in the Azure VNet (z1), which is used for web proxy services (nl6).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7) and links that indicate a segmented and secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' (n19) that manages IaC (nl31), indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n11) in the Management Zone (z3), which is used for AAA services (nl7).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Private connection' (zl1) between the Azure VNet (z1) and the On-Premises Datacenter (z2) via a VPN, and an 'AAA Server' (n11) that manages AAA for the bastion (nl7).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n12) in the Azure VNet (z1), which is used for NIDS monitoring (nl8).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) that routes traffic between different zones (e.g., zl3, zl4, zl5), indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Manager' (n20) that enforces access control (nl32).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a link (nl9) from the 'Central Firewall' (n2) to the 'SIEM' (n13) for flow logs, indicating collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive (z4) and non-sensitive (z5) data, which can be interpreted as production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Workstation' (n16) in the External Testing Zone (z6) and links for penetration testing (nl_new2, nl_new3, nl_new4, nl_new5).

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z4 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z5 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Azure Bastion (n5) and an AAA Server (n11) linked for management (nl7), but there is no explicit evidence of MFA being required for remote access.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of MFA requirement for remote access.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a label or node indicating MFA is required for remote access.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices and services, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or labels indicating the use of version-controlled IaC and secure network protocols.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Azure Bastion (n5) and an AAA Server (n11) linked for management (nl7), but there is no explicit evidence of access control based on up-to-date software, configuration compliance, and OS/app updates.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control criteria.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a label or node indicating access control criteria are enforced.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Workstation (n16) in the External Testing Zone (z6), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a label or node indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.
